title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-28
lineage: 16-Track Master Reel> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN, with various patches (see info file)

ai_review.summary: Studio‑quality soundboard capture of a monster Fillmore West ’69 show – incendiary Eleven, soaring Alligator > Caution jam and a legendary Dark Star sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is essentially studio‑like, pulled from the same tapes used for the Live/Dead album, delivering crystal‑clear mix and full band balance. Musically the concert is often called the “beast” of the Fillmore run, with a second set that strings together a scorching Eleven, an all‑out Alligator > Caution > Feedback > And We Bid You Goodnight jam, plus a powerful Dark Star/St. Stephen segment and a searing Lovelight. Reviewers rave about the seamless transitions, the “greatest‑hits” setlist, and the peak performances of Garcia’s guitar tone and Phil’s bass lock‑step.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 detailed reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5 stars, praising both performance and recording; only a single moderate review notes minor mastering quirks, so the combined weight of show (70%) and recording (30%) yields an excellent overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Studio‑like clarity from the Live/Dead tapes; crisp, well‑balanced mix. One reviewer notes a channel reversal and slight patch timing issues in the master, but these do not detract from overall superb sound.

standout_songs: Alligator > Caution > Feedback > And We Bid You Goodnight jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: A “greatest‑hits” progression that builds to a monster second set; transitions are seamless (Cryptical > Too > Cryptical, Other One into Dark Star, etc.), delivering relentless energy from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is repeatedly praised – especially on Lovelight and throughout the Eleven and jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work is highlighted as “lock‑step” with Jerry during the Eleven, delivering an intense, interwoven groove.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s rhythm guitar and vocals are noted as solid foundations, though not singled out for extraordinary moments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart’s drumming drives the extended jams (Alligator, Caution, Feedback) with power and precision.
